_comment: The ONE settings file for both deployments. Copy to config/<tenant>.json, edit, then run: python bulkaccess.py apply --config config/<tenant>.json. Credentials are NOT stored here: set SAIL_BASE_URL, SAIL_CLIENT_ID and SAIL_CLIENT_SECRET (a PAT of an ORG_ADMIN) in the environment or in the .env file named below.

inc.message: Enter a ServiceNow incident number: INC followed by 7 digits, e.g. INC0012345.

people._comment: max: null = no limit (the Launcher form is always capped at 30 by SailPoint). The plugin files direct requests 10 people at a time. Through the Launcher, requests above partSize (at most 250, SailPoint's workflow loop limit) are sent as several Launcher runs with the same INC.

temporaryAccess._comment: Lets requesters choose access that is removed automatically. The Launcher offers durations only; the plugin also offers an end date.

notifications._comment: The Launcher workflow emails the requester once the access is requested (or when it stops a request), saying what was asked, why and where to go next, with links into the tenant. overrideRecipients: send all mail there instead (demo and test tenants). helpContact: the 'Need help?' line (text; web and email addresses become links), null = 'Contact your SailPoint administrator.' uiBaseUrl: the tenant's UI address for the links, null = derived from SAIL_BASE_URL (https://acme.api.identitynow.com -> https://acme.identitynow.com).

access._comment: The Launcher Access profile decides who may make bulk requests (the Launchpad form and the plugin). Who approves requests for it: MANAGER (the requester's manager) or NONE (auto-approved).

plugin._comment: submit: direct (default) = the plugin files the access requests itself, as the signed-in user, so they carry the requester's name and each item is approved the way it's set up in SailPoint (the tenant must let users request access for others; plugin/install.py checks and otherwise uses the Launcher). launcher = the plugin starts the Launcher and submits its form as the signed-in user; the Launcher workflow then files the requests. Either way only holders of the Launcher Access profile may submit.

approvals._comment: The plugin's Approvals tab: item approvers (access profile owners, managers, ...) approve or deny everything one bulk request (one INC) created for them in one action, as their own decision. concurrency: 1..8 decisions at a time. useBulkEndpoint: auto, always or never (SailPoint's 50-at-a-time bulk endpoint). maxRows: 250..20000 pending approvals loaded. showOther: also list approvals that aren't from a bulk request. Approvers who aren't ORG_ADMIN need to see the plugin (plugin.public, or the plugin's restrictToUsers).
